content:
MacRumors reported that, in addition to the event Apple is expected to hold on October 13, the company is also planning to announce another batch of new products in the final week of the month. Details below.

New Mac models and an iPad mini with an OLED display are expected to launch before the end of the year.

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman said over the weekend that Apple will indeed hold an event on October 13, where it will unveil "the long-awaited, screen-equipped smart home hub, a new HomePod mini, and an updated Apple TV."

Gurman's report comes amid uncertainty over whether Apple will hold an in-person event, or instead reveal its new products through video and press releases as it has in the past. Gurman had previously only said Apple would unveil these products on October 13, without specifying how they would be announced.

Beyond the three products mentioned above, the market also expects Apple to announce a new iPad mini with an OLED display, along with several new Macs, including an updated iMac with the M6 chip and a MacBook Pro with a touch-enabled OLED display.

Citing "multiple people familiar with the matter," MacRumors reported that Apple will announce another round of new products in the final week of October.

The report did not specify which products will be announced, nor provide a specific date, nor reveal whether Apple will hold a second event or simply release them via video and press release.

That said, the late-month announcement will cap off an unusually busy October for Apple. This includes the iPhone Duo going on sale on October 23, and Apple is also expected to release its quarterly results within the month.

What are your thoughts on Apple making a second round of product announcements later this month? Let us know in the comments.
